exposure: Birth preparedness and complication readiness (BPCR) practice
outcome: Predictors of good maternal birth outcomes
cohort: 384 postnatal mothers in Debre Tabor Hospital
finding: The study found that antenatal care utilization, BPCR practice, self-preference of health institution, and mode of delivery (specifically, cesarean, assisted breech, and instrumental deliveries) were significantly associated with good maternal birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean, assisted breech, and instrumental deliveries were associated with good maternal birth outcomes.
